reviews.text: 터치보정 애용하고 피부 수동기능도 좋아하는데 지금 완전 최악으로 변했네요. 10년 가까이 스노우만 쓰고 있었는데, 다른 앱들 묘하게 불편하고 유료 유도 너무 심해서 보정할땐 결국 스노우로 돌아왔어요. 근데 점점 유료뿐만 아니라 다른 기능들도 다른 앱들 따라가게 업데이트 되네요? 지금 가장 불편한건 터치보정 세밀하게도 자연스럽게 가능한 게 좋았는데 지금은 터치 한 옆으로 되질 않나 한쪽만 계속 밀리질 않나(픽셀 깨지면서 늘어나는 현상)  원하는 부위는 보정 먹히지도 않고 답답해죽겠네요. 피부 수정에서도 특히 다크서클 브러쉬 크기 너무 커졌어요 하 ㅠㅠㅠ 뭔 눈 밑 문지르면 얼굴 전체가 뿌얘지면서 다 뭉개고 이전엔 자연스럽게 밝아졌는데 이젠 탁하게 변하네요… 진짜 너무 많이 바뀐 거 아닙니까? 기존에 잘 쓰는 사람들도 고려해주셔야죠. 지금 상태 진짜 제가 본 업뎃 중 최악입니다… 유료기능을 쓸 마음도 싹 사라졌어요. 이대로면 그냥 갈아타겠습니다. + 앨범에 자동으로 넣어주는 기능때문에 선호했으나 이제 불편함이 더 커졌습니다.

reviews.title: NEEDS FIXING AGAIN
reviews.text:
Snow has been my go to editing app for a long time, but the app would break every once in a while and some features wouldn’t properly work like they used to. As of right now, there are issues with the “paint” tool which makes it impossible to use. It’s like the whole feature is glitched, you can’t zoom in properly, and the option to adjust the brush size is entirely useless now. I seem to experience issues using the reshape tool as well. 

I truly love using this app so I’m hoping a fix can be made soon, because as of right now it is unusable.

reviews.text: i redownloaded this app to use, and now i see that they charge money to use features that used to be free.

reviews.title: Snow
reviews.text: This should be free what’s the point of this app if you have to pay 😭

reviews.title: 너무 갑작스럽네요
reviews.text:
제가 초6인데 집에서 저 혼자만 아이폰이거든요 근데 갑자기 잘 사용하다가 ‘앱 연령 등급이 전체 이긴 하지만 스노우 AI필터&고화질 카메라의 등급은 15+ 입니다 ‘라는 말도 안되는 말을 들어서 당황스럽네요…심지어 보호자 인증을 하려면 부모님의 아이폰 계정을 입력하라네요..
솔직히 제 기준에서 2년동안 잘 사용하다가 이러니까 참 억지 같네요..

reviews.title: 억까에요
reviews.text:
원래 스노우 잘 쓰던 유저입니다. 렉이 걸릴때도 있지만 잘 쓰고있었는데..ㅠㅠ
왜 15세 이상으로 바뀐걸까요..? 9살 아이도 문제없이 쓰는데 말이죠. 15세 이상으로 바뀌어 스노우를 쓰지 못하게 되었네요ㅠㅠ 그럼 안녕히..

reviews.title: Won’t love it
reviews.text: At the start of downloading this app I was really excited in using the fun filters ,but just as I took a picture and proceeded to downloaded it wouldn’t allow me too and said I must need VIP so now I’m stuck screenshotting my pictures (which sometimes don’t work🙄)

reviews.title: camera changes
reviews.text: why is the front 0.5x gone? and replaced with 0.8x? the front camera is entirely useless now. bring it back or i’m canceling my subscription.

reviews.title: weird zoom effect??
reviews.text: why does the front facing camera zoom in now?? 1x is zoomed in super far and 0.8x looks like 1x. it makes the app basically useless for selfies. i have been using this app to save time on colour correction since 2018, have been paying for VIP for years, but this will probably make me delete the app and find something else

reviews.title: No longer good
reviews.text:
The reason i used snow for so long was because i could use ar filters and there were sliders to turn off the affects that change your face shape so I was able to use ar stickers and still look like myself in photos. That slider is gone and most of the filters change your face now. I’m done with snow until the face morph slider is back

Update: they still haven’t fixed this and now they require a subscription for their “hired” photos which used to be free. Deleting this app.

reviews.title: Lost work because I can’t exit ADs
reviews.text: Having ads is one thing, but having super long ads that last up to 5 minutes, especially ones related to gaming that doesn’t allow you to exit unless you download the games. It’s super predatory. I have had my work lost because there was no way to exit the ads. Other editing apps have ads too but none is anywhere as bad as SNOW.

reviews.title: Doesn’t save your progress
reviews.text: Everytime I leave the app to reply to a message or just leave to go to my home screen, I go back to snow right after to resume my editing and find that NONE of my edits were saved. As I go back to snow for leaving for like 2 seconds, the app restarts and no changes were saved. Horrendous, given a few years ago it would be saved. But every year it just gets worse and worse. It’s so frustrating to spend so much time on an app to edit, just for it to not save or crash as you’re editing.

reviews.title: It’s sizzlin’
reviews.text: Phone so hot I can fry an egg on it. Battery drains rapidly as soon as the app is open. Tf? Get it together.

reviews.title: well…
reviews.text: the makeup filters r glitching

reviews.title: Used to love the app
reviews.text: They changed the interface, now I can’t find any of the filters that I used to use. Whatever they did makes picture taking way too complicated. It’s a shame, I really used to love this app.

reviews.title: HORRIBLE NEW UPDATE
reviews.text: the recent update is absolutely horrible. impossible to edit my pics because of numerous bugs and errors. very laggy and it's sad how it has become.

reviews.title: What’s with the last update?
reviews.text: Honestly Snow has always been my favorite for taking selfies but you guys took the fun away, bring back the previous update

reviews.title: User of 8+ years
reviews.text: it's very sad to see how garbage this app has become. from all the random paywalls to the non stop glitching.. pitiful. this app used to be good and fun to use! the overuse of ai and it barely ever working isn't worth having this on my phone anymore! SNOW... you're days are done. ✌️

reviews.title: PLEASE SWITCH BACK TO THE OLD SYSTEM
reviews.text: This new update is too distorted and unusable. I will be forced to delete after so many years if not returned to the old beauty settings.

reviews.title: horrible
reviews.text: just to summarize, if you dislike AI usage, useless and expensive paywalls, and consistent lag, i do NOT recommend! this app is FULL of AI and vip paywalls, which are unnecessarily expensive especially for an app about taking/editing pictures. notifications about AI slop pop up quite frequently, and you genuinely cannot use the app without having to waste $40 on trying to take a non blurry picture. the app is also VERY laggy and crashes quite easily.

reviews.title: 스노우 이게 뭐하자는건가요
reviews.text:
몇년째 잘쓰고 있는 스노우 유저입니다.
필터를 써서 사진 찍는건 굉장히 좋아요 그런데 최근에 사진 보정할게 있어서 보정할려고 들어갔는데, 모자이크는 뭐 다 유료구요. 보정 필터도 다 유료네요. 뭐하자는건가요 저처럼 돈이 없는 사람들은 쓰지말라는건가요. 스노우 다른건 필요없고 보정 모자이크하는건 다 무료로 바꿔주세요 무슨 스노우라는 앱은 VIP 전용 앱도 아니고 바꿔주시죠

reviews.title: Music
reviews.text: The editing side is alright…the music is awful can’t choose any viral songs,have to use Spotify with means I have to download it and waste my GB- 1star.

reviews.title: vip
reviews.text: app says vip on everything they should just rename the app to vip vip vip vip vip

reviews.title: I miss the old snow…
reviews.text: Everything is AI, or vip now, almost every filter and feature is locked under vip, and it’s WAY, WAY too expensive… could you not make a shortened subscription, for less? I’ve used this app for 7 years now… Please improve this.. It was my one and only app i ever used for pictures and editing in general.

reviews.title: the app is okay but there is an issue
reviews.text: i miss the old snow where i was able to move my face around or morphe it.  now when i try to change it the parts i morphed moves with the video and my face looks very funny. please change it back !!!!!

reviews.title: They take your money and don’t allow you to use the features promised
reviews.text: I’ve been paying for a subscription for years. My subscription is still active and doesn’t run out for two weeks yet they’ve decided to completely take away ALL my VIP features and have added ADs. They could have at least waited until my subscription ran out but instead I’ve given them money for nothing. Pretty scammy if you ask me

reviews.title: fix the weird overlay
reviews.text: dude this use to be the best app but now it's like everytime i take a photo (even with HD) there's a weird overlay that makes it look like a cheap picsart filter or like AI, it's awful. cancelled my subscription after 2 years because genuinely what makes you think people want their photos to look like that

reviews.title: this app updated to be the worst app ever
reviews.text: i love how they saw picsart charging for everything and thought “hey let me do that too!” this used to be my favorite app to edit photos and put pretty filters on. now, no matter what tool you use, it doesn’t let you save without trying to make you buy premium. i didn’t even use a premium feature and it locked me out of saving my photo. trying to take a screenshot blacks out the screen with a message that says “get vip!!” i deleted this app and will no longer be recommending it to anyone. delete this garbage.

reviews.title: Oof
reviews.text: This app used to be good but now you can't even save more than a few photos without being told you have to pay. What's the point? Been using this app forever and decided to delete it

reviews.title: Changed filters and features
reviews.text: The app was absolutely fine and for no apparent reason you decide to change filters around. The facial ratio thing is disastrous. You got rid of how ‘length’ used to work. Even if I upgraded to premium it would still be bad. You guys seriously messed it up this time. This has been the worst update you’ve ever done! It’s game over at this point. I have been using Soda / Snow for years and now it’s no longer usable. If you’re reading this, do yourself a favour and DONT UPDATE!!!

reviews.title: Over charging for what other apps do for free
reviews.text:
I used to use snow in about 2018 when it first came out, or was popular, and it was a great app that let you edit all your photos in the same way that other photo editing apps did, but for free; now you can’t use a half of the features that you download the app for, without paying $15 a month just to do so?? 
for people like me, a cosplayer living in poverty, can’t afford $15 to do a few touchups, the rare times a year I even get to even take pictures for cosplay photos. so yeah, they suck now. better off downloading one of the free apps I actually like to use features that don’t cost an arm and a leg.

reviews.title: It keeps saying my IOS is incompatible
reviews.text: But it has worked so well this past seven years. I don’t know why it won’t let me use it anymore. It just shows a grey screen.

reviews.title: False Advertising
reviews.text: Why not just make people pay instead of downloading the app anymore, especially for a subscription? I miss using the ads, since at least I can use the editing for an occasional use. Anyone paying to use this must have a lot to spend, or need it for an influencer-like job

reviews.title: crashing
reviews.text: use to love it but now it nonstop crashes :(
